name: Eatransform Auto Keyword Linker
author: eatransform

sections.description:
Eatransform Auto Keyword Linker is a simple and powerful plugin that automatically converts keywords in your posts and pages into links.

Perfect for:
* Internal linking strategy
* Affiliate marketing
* Building content connections
* SEO optimization

Features

  • Unlimited Keywords – Add as many keywords as you want
  • Flexible Linking – Choose to link first occurrence or all occurrences
  • Target Control – Open links in new tab or same tab
  • SEO Options – Add nofollow attribute when needed
  • Simple Interface – Clean and easy-to-use admin panel
  • Lightweight – No bloat, just what you need
  • Free Forever – No premium version nagging

How It Works

  1. Add keywords and their target URLs in the admin panel
  2. Choose your link options (new tab, nofollow, link all, etc.)
  3. The plugin automatically converts keywords to links in your content
  4. That’s it!

Perfect For

  • Bloggers who want to improve internal linking
  • Affiliate marketers managing product links
  • Content creators building topic clusters
  • SEO professionals optimizing site structure
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/eatransform-auto-keyword-linker
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘Keyword Linker’ in the admin menu
  4. Add your first keyword and URL
  5. Save and enjoy automatic linking!
sections.faq:
Is there a limit on keywords?

No! Add unlimited keywords for free.

Can I link all occurrences of a keyword?

Yes! You can choose to link only the first occurrence (default) or all occurrences.

Does it work with existing content?

Yes! It works on all published posts and pages automatically.

Can I use it for affiliate links?

Absolutely! It’s perfect for managing affiliate links.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.
